title: SAP security advisory – October 2026 monthly rollup (AV26-1030)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-1030 Date: October 13, 2026 As of October 13, 2026, SAP_SE is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products: SAP Cloud SDK Prior to 0.45.2 SAP Commerce Cloud (OOTB Code) Version COM_CLOUD 2211-JDK21 SAP Manufacturing Integration and Intelligence (Configuration Service) Version 15.5 Version XMII 15.4 SAP NetWeaver Visual Composer Version VC70RUNTIME 7.50 SAP NetWeaver and SAP Web Dispatcher (Internet Communication Manager) Versions HDB 2.00, KRNL64UC 7.53, WEBDISP 7.53, 7.54, 7.77, 7.93, 9.16, XS_ADVANCED_RUNTIME 1.00, SAP_EXTENDED_APP_SERVICES 1, CONTSERV 7.53, 7.54, KERNEL 7.53, 7.54, 7.77, 7.93, 9.16, 9.18, 9.19 and 9.20 SAP S/4HANA (Manage Substitution/Validation Rules) Versions S4CORE 105, 106, 107, 108, 109 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web link and apply any necessary updates as they become available. SAP Security Patch Day – October 2026 Article Link: SAP security advisory – October 2026 monthly rollup (AV26-1030) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
